name: @calendar-flex/api
description: calendar-flex API: Node 24 LTS + TypeScript + Fastify REST facade over CalDAV (D-01). Every route but GET /healthz needs a Zitadel access token validated against its JWKS (E05-R01).

scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json migrate.config.json src test migrations "sabredav/*.mjs" "sabredav/*.json"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --types node --allowJs --checkJs --module nodenext --target es2023 src/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs migrations/*.mjs sabredav/*.mjs
